card.name: Start of capitalized brand drug names
card.fires_on: The first letters of an all-caps brand drug name (such as Y in YARTEMLEA or V in VIZAMYL) in label text, usually right after a phrase like 'treatment with' or 'preparation of'. Also fires on some section-opening words, such as a space after 'In Study'.

modes.label: Brand name start
modes.description: First piece of an uppercase brand name being spelled out in a label sentence.
modes.example: Following dilution of<< Y>>ARTEMLEA in the infusion bag

modes.label: Sentence or clause openers
modes.description: A word that opens a new instruction or example clause, such as 'Advise' or 'such'.
